status_semantics.CURRENT_SUFFICIENT: The exact bound bytes currently support only the narrowly stated evidence class; this status never expands historical membership or local-file identity into live account, entitlement, routing, inference, or countability authority.
status_semantics.REFRESH_REQUIRED: Freshness-bounded evidence is stale, consumed, absent, or outside its half-open validity window and must be replaced by a newly authorized and independently reviewed metadata-only receipt before final grants.
status_semantics.BLOCKED_PENDING_CLAUDE_V8_REVIEW: The provider-free v8 producer closure is not a live execution path and remains blocked until a fresh independent v8 review and P0 v10 reclosure both pass.

expiry_semantics.window: Validity is half-open: not_before <= trusted_now < expires_at, or checked_at <= trusted_now < fresh_until.
expiry_semantics.exact_boundary: At trusted_now == expires_at or trusted_now == fresh_until the evidence is stale and status is REFRESH_REQUIRED.
expiry_semantics.missing_provider_login_expiry: Absence of a provider-reported login expiry does not remove the audit freshness deadline.
expiry_semantics.immutable_evidence: Frozen membership interpretation and reviewed file hashes do not expire as historical facts; any byte drift invalidates their exact binding, and they never prove current account/session readiness.

inference_readback_contract.model_attribution: A sealed real inference terminal may establish only that its sole successful provider result event reported model claude-opus-5-5.
inference_readback_contract.membership_or_entitlement: A result-event model field does not establish current catalog membership or entitlement and does not replace the separately held catalog artifact required by the driver design.
inference_readback_contract.account_readback: No inspected terminal, result, Engine-readback, or evidence schema carries provider account identity or account-equality proof.
inference_readback_contract.engine_readback: Engine readback is a local SQLite scheduler/job/slot/attempt/prompt-binding readback, not provider model or account readback.

preconditions: fresh independent Claude-v8 review is CLEAN
exact current binary bytes and SHA-256 still match the held binary identity
a new exact metadata-only preflight grant and independent review bind the current binary, account-readiness command, catalog command, owner-private custody, half-open window, and zero-retry policy

sequence.name: account_session_readiness
sequence.required_result: READY receipt with checked_at and fresh_until, sanitized non-identifying projection, owner-private raw custody, and independent CLEAN review

sequence.name: model_membership_entitlement
sequence.required_result: one authoritative terminal result containing exact display token Opus 5.5 once, with assistant stream copies ignored, owner-private raw custody, and independent CLEAN interpretation review

minimal_metadata_only_preflight_immediat.final_grant_rule: Issue final inference grants only while both new receipts and their reviews remain inside the same overlapping half-open validity window; any stale time, drift, ambiguity, or unknown outcome is STOP with no retry or follow-up request.

claim_limits: read-only local evidence audit plus inert audit artifacts only
no live authority, activation, provider readiness, inference success, account equality, current entitlement, countable A/B evidence, provider superiority, or runtime acceptance
provider-free v8 producer evidence cannot substitute for fresh independent review, P0 v10 reclosure, or intended-runtime acceptance
